## Processing Notes

Multi-year aerial imagery of Philadelphia. Source imagery downloaded from PASDA
(Pennsylvania Spatial Data Access System). All tiles converted to Cloud-Optimized
GeoTIFF (COG) format with consistent settings:

- Compression: JPEG (YCbCr color space)
- Quality: 95
- Internal tiling: 512x512 pixels
- Overviews: Automatically generated

Each year is a separate STAC collection containing ~950 tiles covering the full
city extent. Ground sample distance (GSD) is 3 inches (0.0762 meters).
Coordinate reference system: NAD83 / Pennsylvania South (ftUS) - EPSG:2272.
